question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The Egyptians developed ways to prevent the dead body from ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1) i.e. '****decaying'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about how Egyptians developed ways of turning dead bodies into mummies to prevent them from decaying.
 
• Therefore, the most **appropriate word **to be filled in the blank is **'****decaying.'**
 
• The word 'd**ecaying' means ****to become gradually damaged, worse, or less.**
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• ​*The neighbours discovered the **decaying** body of Mr Asutosh in his flat.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the** correct answer is option 1.**

 

**Complete Sentence:**__ *The Egyptians developed ways to prevent the dead body from **__decaying__**.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s look at the meaning of other options

 
 

 **Word**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 Destroying
 to damage something so badly that it cannot be used
 
 

 Drooping
 bending or hanging down heavily
 
 

 Dying
 very ill and likely to die soon
